acceptance: The wave ends when the last running cycle seals after a halt
fix: A system-failure halt stops backfill at once, lets running cycles finish, emits LOOP_ORCH_HALT_DRAINING (INCIDENT) with the cause, and ends the wave when the pool is empty. The idle cause is system_halt, not operator_stop.
summary: Wave 182: after LOOP_SYSTEM_FAILURE_HALT at 23:26:22Z the pool backfilled lanes at 23:26:22Z and 23:36:28Z, then idled 3h38m with cause=operator_stop (go/internal/orchestrator/idle_cause.go:19-22,50-53; go/internal/orchestrator/pool.go:83) until the wave ended at 03:19Z.
title: after a system-failure halt the pool still backfills lanes and idles for hours labelled operator_stop
